summary: Medical office construction starts fell to a 10-year low in the third quarter while demand outpaced new deliveries for the fourth straight quarter, so outpatient space is getting harder to find. Health systems keep buying outpatient capacity at scale, led by a Bon Secours Mercy Health affiliate's offer for Surgery Partners, now valued at about $6 billion, as hospital margins stay thin. On the marketing side, new Content Marketing Institute research shows B2B teams shifting budget to owned media as AI search cuts website traffic, and buyers trust practical, expert content most.

topStories.title: Medical office construction starts fall to a 10-year low
topStories.summary: Per Avison Young, third-quarter medical office starts totaled 987,000 square feet, down 64% from a year earlier and 54% from the second quarter. Net absorption rose 61% from the second quarter to 4.1 million square feet, the highest since late 2021, and demand exceeded new deliveries for the fourth straight quarter. Tighter conditions are pushing rents up.
topStories.whyItMatters: With little new supply coming, health systems that need outpatient space in the next few years will have to build it. Starting development and financing decisions early is the way to secure it.

topStories.title: Ascension plans $8M outpatient imaging center
topStories.summary: Ascension Via Christi plans a 6,300 square foot standalone imaging center in southwest Wichita with MRI, CT, mammography, DEXA, ultrasound and fluoroscopy, plus a pad for future PET/CT. Groundbreaking is set for early 2027 and opening for the first half of 2028. Other area imaging centers are at or near capacity.
topStories.whyItMatters: Systems are still adding small-format outpatient imaging where capacity is tight, even as payment rules for off-campus imaging change in 2027.

topStories.title: HealthSpan Partners ups Surgery Partners offer to $6B after rival bid
topStories.summary: The Bon Secours Mercy Health affiliate raised its cash offer to $25 a share from $23.50 after an unsolicited $28 bid that Bloomberg reported came from UnitedHealth. Surgery Partners operates over 200 short-stay surgical facilities in 30 states. Ascension's $3.9 billion Amsurg deal brought it more than 250 locations.
topStories.whyItMatters: Health systems are paying billions to own ambulatory surgery. Systems without that scale will look for faster, capital-light ways to add ASC capacity in their own markets.

topStories.title: CMS sets the details for site-neutral imaging pay in 2027
topStories.summary: From Jan. 1, 2027, a 40% Physician Fee Schedule relativity adjustment applies to imaging without contrast at certain off-campus hospital outpatient sites, reducing outpatient spending by an estimated $260 million next year. New NPI and attestation requirements for off-campus hospital outpatient departments begin Jan. 1, 2028. The median adjusted year-to-date hospital operating margin was 1.1% in September.
topStories.whyItMatters: The new off-campus requirements and lower imaging rates give systems a reason to review where each outpatient service sits before signing new leases or starting projects.

topStories.title: 45 hospital M&As finalized in 2026
topStories.summary: Recent closings come with large capital commitments. MultiCare completed its Samaritan Health Services affiliation on Nov. 1 with a $700 million, 10-year investment commitment, and WVU Health closed on the five-hospital Independence Health System on Oct. 1 with plans to invest $800 million. Orlando Health acquired a 375-bed hospital and its outpatient facilities.
topStories.whyItMatters: Post-deal investment pledges turn into facility projects, often outpatient sites, in the first years after closing.

topStories.title: OhioHealth to build $700M hospital, its 17th
topStories.summary: OhioHealth New Albany Methodist Hospital will have 160 beds, expandable to 208, across 600,000 square feet, with 325,000 square feet reimagined and 275,000 new. Construction starts in early 2027 with opening in late 2030. OhioHealth already runs 16 hospitals and more than 200 ambulatory sites.
topStories.whyItMatters: Growing regions still draw major campus investment, and new hospitals bring demand for nearby medical office and outpatient space.

trends.title: Outpatient space is getting scarce
trends.detail: Medical office starts are at a 10-year low while absorption is the highest since late 2021, so rents are rising and existing space is filling. Systems that need capacity will lean on new development rather than finding space to lease.

trends.title: Health systems buy ambulatory surgery at scale
trends.detail: Ascension closed on Amsurg and a Bon Secours Mercy Health affiliate is bidding about $6 billion for Surgery Partners. Fitch's Kevin Holloran describes the outpatient approach as asset-light and return-rich, and the ASC market is projected to grow 6.1% a year through 2033.

trends.title: Thin margins and costlier debt favor smaller, phased projects
trends.detail: The median hospital margin was 1.1% year to date in September. In a Marsh survey reported by HFMA, 40% of systems plan to issue new debt in 2026 and capital is moving from major growth initiatives to smaller projects.

trends.title: Partnership models fund new medical office buildings
trends.detail: UK HealthCare's $275 million, 220,000 square foot medical office building is a public-private partnership: the developer designs, builds, finances and operates it on a 65-year ground lease and leases it back to the system for 15 years.

items.summary: A 220,000 square foot building delivered through a public-private partnership with a 65-year ground lease and a 15-year leaseback; about 300,000 outpatient visits a year expected by 2034.

items.title: OhioHealth to build $700M hospital, its 17th
items.summary: A 160-bed hospital in New Albany, Ohio, with construction starting in early 2027 and opening in late 2030.

items.title: Sutter hospital to get $189M expansion
items.summary: Sutter's board approved a first phase at Memorial Medical Center in Modesto, Calif., next to a 165,000 square foot cancer center opening in 2029.

items.title: HealthSpan Partners ups Surgery Partners offer to $6B after rival bid
items.summary: The offer rose to $25 a share after a rival $28 bid; closing is expected in the first quarter of 2027.

items.title: Ascension, Bon Secours make multibillion-dollar bets on ASCs
items.summary: Ascension's ASC network stands at 312 facilities after the Amsurg deal, and Bon Secours Mercy Health is pursuing Surgery Partners.

items.title: 45 hospital M&As finalized in 2026
items.summary: Closings include MultiCare and Samaritan with a $700 million investment pledge and WVU Health and Independence Health System with $800 million planned.

items.title: Market worries overtake policy concerns
items.summary: 52% of surveyed systems drew on investment reserves in 2025, 40% plan new debt in 2026, and capital is shifting toward smaller projects.

items.title: Is this the last year of peak hospital growth?
items.summary: Hospitals' share of provider profits is expected to fall from 41% in 2019 to about 38% by 2029 as care shifts to freestanding sites; the ASC market is projected to reach $72.7 billion by 2033.

items.title: Gist Weekly: November 20, 2026
items.summary: Site-neutral imaging pay starts Jan. 1, 2027 with a 40% adjustment; new NPI and attestation rules for off-campus hospital outpatient departments start Jan. 1, 2028.

items.title: Hospitals split on CMS' outpatient rule
items.summary: The AHA called the site-neutral expansion misguided while the Federation of American Hospitals called the rule a win for patients and taxpayers.

items.title: Faster and cheaper, but not better: the 2027 B2B Content and Marketing Trends Report
items.summary: Owned media is the top 2027 investment area at 42%, up 10 points. 31% of marketers report lower website traffic, and 79% of them blame AI-powered search.
items.takeaway: Put more into Boldt's own site and blog, and write pages that answer questions directly so AI tools cite them.

items.title: What builds trust with B2B buyers
items.summary: Marketers rank useful, practical information (64%), industry expertise (59%) and customer stories (50%) as the top trust builders, ahead of original research (27%).
items.takeaway: Lead with practical planning guidance and project stories from Boldt's experts.

items.title: Fast, cheap, and forgettable: what AI is really contributing to B2B marketing
items.summary: 78% say speed is AI's biggest contribution and only 17% say quality. 75% fear AI is eroding audience trust, yet 52% have no AI disclosure policy.
items.takeaway: Use AI to speed up drafts, but keep expert review and Boldt-specific detail in every piece.

items.title: Google November 2026 core update: what marketers should know
items.summary: Google began rolling out its third core update of 2026 on Nov. 10, with up to two weeks to finish, and advises waiting a full week after rollout before comparing Search Console data.
items.takeaway: Hold off on judging blog traffic changes until early December.

items.title: November 2026 Google Webmaster Report
items.summary: AI Overviews now appear on 80% of Google searches, and Google updated its guidance to say AI-generated content should be fact-checked and reviewed.
items.takeaway: Clear answers, FAQs and named expert authors help Boldt's pages show up in AI answers.

items.title: LinkedIn launches CTV ads in the UK
items.summary: LinkedIn's connected TV ads, available to US advertisers since April 2024, now reach the UK. LinkedIn says people who saw a brand's CTV ad first cost 30% less to convert into leads.
items.takeaway: Consider a small CTV test alongside the Outlook campaign to warm up target accounts before LinkedIn feed ads.
